summary: Formalize the full PTX 9.4 instruction language and computing model, and support proofs that GPU kernels implement TorchLean network specifications.
Explain the computing model and the conditions of each correctness claim through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted memory and collective models, scalar proof rules, actual computed-data publication, shared-allocation kernels, encoded binary32 arithmetic and a checked affine memory kernel are implemented. A pinned TorchLean graph has automatic backward success and VJP proofs, and an integer tensor-layout bridge connects actual kernel memory to TorchLean tensors. Recorded Luna tasks establish bounded instruction-formalization capability under reviewed contracts. Full PTX coverage, mixed-source observation interpretation, general data-dependent concurrency, broader numerical/tensor interfaces, multi-kernel lifetime and visibility, separately authored backward kernel correspondence and Gemma remain unfinished.
